{{Quote|This is a extremely good body armor for snipers. It doesn't really help you against attacks, but keeps you well-hidden.|Homack, on the camo armor|<ref name="GFT" />}}
The '''camo scout armor''', '''camo armor''', '''camo suit''', or '''camosuit''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] designed by [[Creshaldyne Industries/Legends|Creshaldyne Industries]] to protect the wearer from both injury and detection. Using miniature [[photoreactive fiber]]s, the suit changed its [[Color/Legends|color]] to blend into the background. Its hard plates provided protection against damage. Sparsely available throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] since the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;sometimes through the illegal [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]]&mdash;the camo armor was used by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Description==
{{Quote|A camo suit works well on unenhanced vision, but it doesn't provide much of an advantage over species that possess infravision.|Vox|<ref name="GFT" />}}
The camo [[Armor/Legends|armor]],<ref name="G10GFTCW">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''; [[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'' and ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> also known as camo scout armor,<ref name="G10GFTAEG">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''; [[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'' and ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and as camo suit<ref name="GFT" /> or camosuit,<ref name="BOG">{{JournalCite|8|Blaze of Glory (short story)}}</ref> was a protective covering that prevented damage from being inflicted upon the user.<ref name="GG10GFT">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' and ''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> To do so, several hard plates were woven into the fabric<ref name="AEGCW">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' and ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> of a body glove armor<ref name="GG10GFT" /> through the use of a widespread armor technology.<ref name="CW">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

The camo armor was a light item,<ref name="GG10GFT" /> weighing no more than six [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]]. It was classified as a medium armor<ref name="AEGCW" /> and intended to be used by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]&mdash;thus the name "scout armor."<ref name="G10" />

The camo armor based its marketing campaign<ref name="G10GFTAEG" /> on a technological advance of passive defense that increased the hiding or stealth abilities of the user.<ref name="GG10GFT" /> To do so, the camo armor had a network of<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> miniature [[photoreactive fiber]]s embedded within it. Those items allowed the armor to absorb surrounding light and change [[Color/Legends|color]], matching its present environment.<ref name="ROEAEGCW">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''; [[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' and ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> While this tricked [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Eye/Legends|eyesight]], the light- and color-sensitive fibers could not absorb and process every kind of light.<ref name="ROE" /> The individual known as [[Vox (Defel)|Vox]] noticed that it was less than useful against [[Species/Legends|species]] with natural [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] vision or against [[Life-form scanner/Legends|lifeform scanners]],<ref name="GFT" /> including specifically-configured [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]].<ref name="BOG" />

==History==
[[File:CamoArmorGundarkByDeCrotie.png|thumb|left|109px|Camo armor in use]]
{{Quote|Back during my days with the Rebel Alliance, I had a suit of camo armor in my X-Wing's survival gear kit.|Homack|<ref name="GFT" />}}
Developed by [[Creshaldyne Industries/Legends|Creshaldyne Industries]],<ref name="G10GFTAEG" /> the camo armor was commercially available, with a price of 6,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]],<ref name="AEG" /> from the last days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] onward,<ref name="AEGCW" /> although frequently only in limited areas.<ref name="CW" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], users of the camo armor included a number of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]],<ref name="G10" /> and sometimes members of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] who wore camo armor for both protection and furtiveness.<ref name="ROE" /> [[Homack]], a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], kept one suit of camo armor in the [[Survival kit/Legends|survival kit]] of his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] and opined that [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] could profit from its use. Once, he was shot down and crash-landed on [[Atrivis]]. Thanks to his camo armor, Homack evaded enemy [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commandos]] long enough to steal a [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="GFT" />

In the first days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the camo armor was available through [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]], the illegal database of the arms [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Gundark (arms dealer)|Gundark]]. Homack posted a message there about the advantages of the camo armor and his own experiences with it; he was answered by Vox, who listed the perceived disadvantages of the item.<ref name="GFT" />

Circa [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], members of the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]] used camo armor and mounts to patrol the perimeter of their camp on [[Gabredor III/Legends|Gabredor III]]. An enemy [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[unit]], the [[Red Moons]], detected these riders using macrobinoculars, and one of the camo-using [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] was defeated by mercenaries [[Lex Kempo]] and [[Sully Tigereye]].<ref name="BOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Lightscoutarmorandshadowsuit.png|thumb|right|200px|The light scout armor (left)]]
Camo scout armor was first mentioned in the sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' ([[1994]]), written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Its stats were repeated, along with new information and the first illustration depicting the item (by an uncredited artist), in ''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'' ([[1997]]), written for the same game. Both sources list the camo as a light armor, more effective against physical damage than against energy, and available for 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' ([[2002]]), written for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', and ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' ([[2009]]), written for Wizards' [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook|''Saga Edition Roleplaying Game'']], both classify the same item as a medium armor, more difficult to use, equally effective against all kinds of damage, and valued in 6,000 credits. ''The Clone Wars Campaign Guide'' also considers this item to be particularly hard to obtain. When in conflict, this article gives precedence to the more recent source.

''Arms & Equipment Guide'' also included a new illustration of the camo armor by [[Chris Trevas]]; however, this depiction was quite different than the one in ''Fantastic Technology'', being instead similar to a [[light scout armor]] seen in the book ''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]'' ([[1997]]).<!--This might be Trevas' mistake, or a demonstration of the camouflage abilities of the armor-->
